name: Coin Run
note: Collect coins using only rendered pixels. Seeded 10×10 world; fixed-horizon score.
description: Guide the cyan player around a grid and collect yellow coins. Each move tests visual localization and a short route to the next target.
media_credit: Daniel Tremer / GeneralGameBench
media_caption: Recorded coin-run task with the random reference policy. Consecutive evaluation frames at 6 fps; playback speed does not measure reaction time.

name: Dodge Lanes
note: Avoid falling obstacles. Two local visual policies and controls are included.
description: Dodge falling red blocks by moving between lanes. Staying alive requires noticing approaching obstacles and choosing a safe position.
media_credit: Daniel Tremer / GeneralGameBench
media_caption: Recorded dodge-lanes task with the random reference policy. Consecutive evaluation frames at 6 fps; playback speed does not measure reaction time.

name: ViZDoom · eight scenarios
note: Basic, defend center, defend line, take cover, health gathering, corridor, home and prediction. These are eight scenarios of one game family.
description: First-person Doom tasks cover aiming, navigation, defense and survival. Eight scenarios share one game engine and present different control challenges.

media_caption: Recorded doom-basic task with the random reference policy. Consecutive evaluation frames at 6 fps; playback speed does not measure reaction time.

name: SuperTuxKart
note: Validated Lighthouse time trial with the deterministic-render-v1 engine patch and Linux ARM64 renderer. Exact 200-action image/score replay passed with varied action delays. One kart and one track only; v0.2 model standings are unchanged.
description: Race karts through colorful tracks with drifting, obstacles and power-ups. The game also includes battle, soccer and collection modes.
media_credit: SuperTuxKart contributors
media_caption: Recorded supertuxkart-lighthouse task with the random reference policy. Consecutive evaluation frames at 6 fps; playback speed does not measure reaction time.

name: Luanti

description: Explore, dig and build in voxel worlds created with the Luanti engine. Its community games range from open-ended survival to focused platforming tasks.
media_credit: Luanti / Minetest Game contributors
media_caption: Recorded luanti-chop-tree task with the random reference policy. Consecutive evaluation frames at 6 fps; playback speed does not measure reaction time.

name: Veloren

media_credit: GeneralGameBench capture; Veloren contributors
media_caption: Native prototype capture. Exact visual replay failed; this candidate has no admitted task or ranking. Consecutive frames at 6 fps do not measure reaction time.

name: Factorio
note: Official Lua API can implement a trusted referee. Agents would receive screenshots only. Game license and deterministic scenario needed. No usable local installation was available for this integration pass.
